text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
At the year-end Grand Prix—the Arima

Kinen—standing at the top of all these
amazing
classic and senior racers is...

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin! She's seized victory with
her
unprecedentedly powerful final
sprint!

text_block_list.name: Taishin's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Dear... Look at how strong you are. Look
how
strong you've become!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Winning Ticket hoists Narita Taishin
atop her
shoulders—with Biwa Hayahide
lending a steady
hand on her back to
keep her from falling.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With her head held higher than anyone
else's,
Narita Taishin basks in the
thunderous applause
and booming
cheers that never seem to end.
